newsitem.title: UK: Yates Brothers placing to raise 7.5 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Yates Brothers placing to raise 7.5 mln stg.

text.p: Wine retailer Yates Brothers Wine Lodges Plc said on Tuesday that it has agreed to place 1.97 million new ordinary shares at a price of 385p per share to raise around 7.5 million stg.

The shares, which represent around five percent of the company's ordinary share capital, are being placed through Panmure Gordon & Co Ltd and will be used to provide funds for the continued expansion of the Yate's Wine Lodges branded retail eastates.
Yates said it expected that dealings will commence on November 15.
